title: Session ID not rotated after login (session fixation)
description: The PHPSESSID remains identical before and after successful authentication. If an attacker can preseed a known session ID on the victim's browser, they can hijack the session after the victim logs in.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/login.php; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=oh7b9qbtd9c0dueninuaf8i9h1; path=/ Set-Cookie: security=low
